h1: Vail ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Vail is 5,317 acres over 278 trails, and more than half of it is graded advanced. Thirty-two lifts serve a mountain topping out at 3,527 metres, the Back Bowls run behind the front face, and Riva Ridge drops four miles from the ridge to the village.
stayOverview: Vail Village and Lionshead are the two base villages, each with its own gondola, and East Vail is the cheaper end of the valley. The choice is which lift you walk to.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. Both base villages are pedestrian and both reach the mountain directly, so the decision is about restaurants rather than access.
rentalCars: Vail sits on Interstate 70 about two hours west of Denver, and the villages are walkable once you arrive.
